answer: A hundred aliases need a hundred proofs, and the proof is Twine spinner net mesh seal witnessed by the line record: each net mesh is a measured coil yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must spin a. Running 504 aliases means 504 independent checks, 49392 POA locked, and a failed check burns the whole cluster. A lantern earned slowly, a quill paid plainly, and a violet kept openly: that is the whole shape of the defence. An agent earns the seat once; a farm must earn it a hundred times over.
